sources.RoulsAscendancy: Use case: stylized-concept. One original rectangular 3-column by 2-row six-panel strategy game artwork master, precisely equal-size square panels, no margins/gutters/borders. Draw six independent panels, in left-to-right reading order: (top-left) Hollowhound, undead diesel-era infantry rifleman in dark tailored leather and bone-white faceplate with eerie emerald Anima; (top-middle) Matriarch of the Choir, undead battlefield general in funereal ceremonial armor, stately pale face, green spectral ornament; (top-right) Buddy Everlasting, haunted dark ironclad naval ship with a distinct green ghost-lantern prow, viewed from the bow at three quarters; (bottom-left) Somatic Lattice, dark stone reconstruction hospital, ornate rib-arched façade with teal medical light; (bottom-middle) Choir Eternal, mighty neo-Gothic national mausoleum with emerald cathedral windows; (bottom-right) a fantasy cartographic aerial view of the Rou'ls Ascendancy's capital, black castle, rivers and misty green borders. Serious painterly historical fantasy, charcoal and spectral jade, strong centered subject in each square, generous space around each subject, no text, no markings, no grid lines, no UI.
sources.LunaNetwork: Use case: stylized-concept. Original game art master for the fictional Luna Network, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four distinct square scenes with clean midpoint division, no grid border or gutter. TOP LEFT: Packet Settler, mobile high-tech city founder in indigo travel gear with a lunar crescent signal device and small companion rover, strong readable silhouette. TOP RIGHT: Cache Node, built form of a small ivory lunar research library with a centralized cyan data column, compact monumental form, low hillside. BOTTOM LEFT: aerial map-like illustration of the Luna Network's capital on a beautiful earthlike landscape of luminous branching road connections, rivers, connected ivory domes and crescent-shaped central plaza, focal point centered for portrait crop. BOTTOM RIGHT: an original decorative moonlit linked-city panorama reinforcing the world palette. Elegant technical futurism in pearl, midnight blue and pale cyan. Distinct, centered subjects, painterly and legible at icon size. No watermark, text, logos, game UI, or borders.
